options.name: allowOnlyReservedLeases
options.description: Stop dynamic IP address allocation and allocate only reserved IP addresses

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: blockLocallyAdministeredMacAddresses
options.description: Stop dynamic IP address allocation for clients with locally administered MAC addresses

options.name: bootFileName
options.description: The boot file name stored on the bootstrap TFTP server to be used by clients

options.name: capwapAcIpAddresses
options.description: List of CAPWAP Access Controller IP addresses for Wireless Termination Points

options.name: dnsServers
options.description: List of DNS server IP addresses to be used by the clients Ignored when useThisDnsServer is set to true

options.name: dnsTtl
options.description: The TTL value in seconds used for forward and reverse DNS records

options.name: dnsUpdates
options.description: Allow the DHCP server to automatically update forward and reverse DNS entries for clients

options.name: domainName
options.description: The domain name to be used by this network The DHCP server automatically adds forward and reverse DNS entries when configured

options.name: domainSearchList
options.description: List of domain names that clients can use as a suffix when searching a domain name

options.name: endingAddress
options.description: The ending IP address of the DHCP scope Required when creating a new scope

options.name: exclusions
options.description: List of IP address ranges to exclude from dynamic allocation

options.name: genericOptions
options.description: List of generic DHCP options not directly supported

options.name: ignoreClientIdentifierOption
options.description: Always use the client's MAC address as the identifier instead of Client Identifier option

options.name: leaseTimeDays
options.description: The lease time in number of days

options.name: leaseTimeHours
options.description: The lease time in number of hours

options.name: leaseTimeMinutes
options.description: The lease time in number of minutes

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DHCP scope

options.name: newName
options.description: The new name of the DHCP scope to rename an existing scope

options.name: ntpServerDomainNames
options.description: List of NTP server domain names that the DHCP server should automatically resolve

options.name: ntpServers
options.description: List of Network Time Protocol (NTP) server IP addresses to be used by the clients

options.name: offerDelayTime
options.description: The time duration in milliseconds that the DHCP server delays sending an DHCPOFFER message

options.name: pingCheckEnabled
options.description: Allow the DHCP server to check if an IP address is already in use to prevent IP address conflicts

options.name: pingCheckRetries
options.description: The maximum number of ping requests to try

options.name: pingCheckTimeout
options.description: The timeout interval in milliseconds to wait for a ping reply

options.name: reservedLeases
options.description: List of reserved IP addresses to assign to specific clients

options.name: routerAddress
options.description: The default gateway IP address to be used by the clients

options.name: serverAddress
options.description: The IP address of next server (TFTP) to use in bootstrap by the clients If not specified, the DHCP server's IP address is used

options.name: serverHostName
options.description: The optional bootstrap server host name to be used by clients to identify the TFTP server

options.name: startingAddress
options.description: The starting IP address of the DHCP scope Required when creating a new scope

options.name: staticRoutes
options.description: List of static routes for clients

options.name: subnetMask
options.description: The subnet mask of the network Required when creating a new scope

options.name: tftpServerAddresses
options.description: List of TFTP Server addresses or VoIP Configuration Server addresses

options.name: useThisDnsServer
options.description: Use this DNS server's IP address to configure the DNS Servers DHCP option for clients

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests

options.name: vendorInfo
options.description: List of vendor information entries

options.name: winsServers
options.description: List of NBNS/WINS server IP addresses to be used by the clients
